exact.Il n’est pas nécessaire de retenir son s: There is no need to hold your breath. If you have breathing difficulties or dizziness, or if the exercise increases your anxiety, stop and choose grounding through the senses or another suitable approach instead.

exact.Contractez très légèrement les jambes si: Tense your legs very lightly if that feels right, then release.
exact.Ne forcez jamais et évitez toute zone do: Never force anything, and avoid any painful, injured or sensitive area. You can simply notice your muscles and relax them without tensing them.
exact.La relaxation ne doit pas devenir une co: Relaxation should not become a requirement before facing uncertainty. You can also choose to let the discomfort be there while carrying on with a reasonable action.
